SELECT r.* FROM gkzh_nlld_record r
ORDER BY r.record_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_type = 'top2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS top2Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_type = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.answered_rounds > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS startedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.poster_saved = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS savedCount FROM gkzh_nlld_record r

SELECT a.dimension_code AS dimensionCode, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_nlld_answer a JOIN gkzh_nlld_record r ON r.record_id = a.record_id
GROUP BY a.dimension_code

SELECT t.dimension_code AS dimensionCode, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM ( SELECT a.record_id, a.dimension_code FROM gkzh_nlld_answer a JOIN gkzh_nlld_record r ON r.record_id = a.record_id
GROUP BY a.record_id, a.dimension_code HAVING COUNT(*) = 2 ) t GROUP BY t.dimension_code

SELECT r.top1_dimension_id AS dimensionId, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM gkzh_nlld_record r
AND r.top1_dimension_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.top1_dimension_id

SELECT r.top2_dimension_id AS dimensionId, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM gkzh_nlld_record r
AND r.top2_dimension_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.top2_dimension_id

SELECT COALESCE(college.department_id, dept.department_id) AS collegeId, COALESCE(college.title, dept.title, '未填写院系') AS collegeName, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_type = 'top2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS top2Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.result_type = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openCount FROM gkzh_nlld_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department dept ON dept.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department college ON college.department_id = dept.parent_id
GROUP BY collegeId, collegeName ORDER BY total DESC, collegeName ASC

SELECT COALESCE(college.department_id, dept.department_id) AS collegeId, COALESCE(college.title, dept.title, '未填写院系') AS collegeName, a.dimension_code AS dimensionCode, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM gkzh_nlld_answer a JOIN gkzh_nlld_record r ON r.record_id = a.record_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department dept ON dept.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department college ON college.department_id = dept.parent_id
GROUP BY collegeId, collegeName, a.dimension_code

SELECT t.collegeId AS collegeId, t.collegeName AS collegeName, t.dimensionCode AS dimensionCode, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(college.department_id, dept.department_id) AS collegeId, COALESCE(college.title, dept.title, '未填写院系') AS collegeName, a.record_id AS recordId, a.dimension_code AS dimensionCode FROM gkzh_nlld_answer a JOIN gkzh_nlld_record r ON r.record_id = a.record_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department dept ON dept.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department college ON college.department_id = dept.parent_id
GROUP BY collegeId, collegeName, a.record_id, a.dimension_code HAVING COUNT(*) = 2 ) t GROUP BY t.collegeId, t.collegeName, t.dimensionCode

SELECT COALESCE(college.department_id, dept.department_id) AS collegeId, COALESCE(college.title, dept.title, '未填写院系') AS collegeName, r.top1_dimension_id AS dimensionId, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM gkzh_nlld_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department dept ON dept.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department college ON college.department_id = dept.parent_id
AND r.top1_dimension_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY collegeId, collegeName, r.top1_dimension_id

SELECT COALESCE(college.department_id, dept.department_id) AS collegeId, COALESCE(college.title, dept.title, '未填写院系') AS collegeName, r.top2_dimension_id AS dimensionId, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM gkzh_nlld_record r LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department dept ON dept.department_id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department college ON college.department_id = dept.parent_id
AND r.top2_dimension_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY collegeId, collegeName, r.top2_dimension_id
